packet_name: Paper VII preregistered empirical extension candidate list
primary_endpoint: Strict family match on new empirical domains only, using the same AICc-based family-selection harness as the canonical 50-domain suite
notes: This file is intended to be uploaded unchanged to OSF or another timestamped registry before data extraction.
The domains listed here are a prospective extension and must not be blended retroactively into the current 25-domain canonical empirical result.
Predictions are locked here; data extraction comes afterward.

domains.target_source: Comparative neuroanatomy datasets such as Jerison or Hofman-style mammalian compilations
domains.inclusion_rule: Use one published cross-species mammalian dataset with at least 20 species and traceable units.
domains.exclusion_risk: Mixed taxonomic groups with incompatible measurement protocols.

domains.domain_name: Aftershock rate vs time since mainshock (Omori law)
domains.target_source: Published seismology catalogs or Omori-law benchmark datasets
domains.inclusion_rule: Use a single aftershock sequence with clear completeness threshold and at least 20 time bins.

domains.target_source: Leopold and Maddock style hydraulic-geometry datasets or a modern equivalent
domains.inclusion_rule: Use one clearly reported at-a-station or downstream hydraulic-geometry dataset with enough points for fitting.
domains.exclusion_risk: Mixing incompatible station types or heavily engineered channels.

domains.target_source: Forest allometry datasets such as Jenkins et al. or a similar published biomass compilation
domains.inclusion_rule: Use one species group or allometric compilation with consistent biomass definitions.
domains.exclusion_risk: Pooling incompatible species classes without preregistered regime separation.

domains.target_source: US Standard Atmosphere measurements or another published atmospheric profile dataset
domains.inclusion_rule: Use one measured or official atmospheric profile with traceable units and at least 10 altitude levels.
domains.exclusion_risk: Using a purely symbolic derivation instead of a reported numeric profile.

domains.target_source: Published laboratory electronics dataset or course-lab dataset with archived numeric values
domains.inclusion_rule: Use one measured RC discharge dataset with at least 10 time points.
domains.exclusion_risk: Synthetic formula values presented as if they were measurements.

domains.target_source: Clinical pharmacokinetic concentration-time dataset for a first-order elimination regime
domains.inclusion_rule: Use one drug/time series with a clearly reported first-order elimination window.
domains.exclusion_risk: Mixing absorption and elimination phases without preregistered windowing.

domains.domain_name: Light transmission vs path length in an absorbing medium
domains.target_source: Published spectrophotometry calibration dataset with measured transmitted intensity
domains.inclusion_rule: Use path-length or concentration sweeps with measured transmission values and at least 10 points.
domains.exclusion_risk: Using absorbance values without converting to the appropriate transmission scale.

domains.target_source: Published enzyme-kinetics dataset with raw substrate and velocity measurements
domains.inclusion_rule: Use one single-enzyme assay with enough substrate concentrations to reveal saturation.
domains.exclusion_risk: Allosteric or cooperative systems masquerading as simple Michaelis-Menten kinetics.

domains.domain_name: Dose-response or receptor occupancy vs concentration
domains.target_source: Published pharmacology or receptor-binding dataset with occupancy/response measurements
domains.inclusion_rule: Use one clearly cooperative or sigmoid response dataset with at least 10 concentration levels.
domains.exclusion_risk: Partial agonist systems or mixed-mechanism assays without a clear monotone saturation regime.

domains.domain_name: Platform or technology adoption vs time in a finite market
domains.target_source: ITU, World Bank, or company adoption data showing a finite-market uptake curve
domains.inclusion_rule: Use one adoption series with enough pre- and post-inflection points to resolve saturation.
domains.exclusion_risk: Early-stage series that have not yet entered the slowing or saturation regime.

domains.domain_name: Microbial growth-rate response vs substrate concentration
domains.target_source: Published Monod-curve dataset with substrate concentration and growth-rate measurements
domains.inclusion_rule: Use one single-substrate assay with enough points to identify a clear saturating response.
domains.exclusion_risk: Multi-substrate limitation or inhibition regimes without preregistered handling.
